metadata.name: centerpiece
metadata.description: Centerpiece game coin, soulbound player badges, keepsake NFTs and round attestations

accounts.name: round
docs: `init` fails if this round was already attested, so a round settles exactly once.

accounts.name: session
docs: The round's session, when it has a table goal. Omit for sessions without one.

accounts.name: award
docs: One receipt per (round, wallet): a second award for the same round fails here.

accounts.name: bonus
docs: `init` makes the bonus claimable once per wallet per session.

accounts.name: authority
docs: The game admin acting for a custodial player, or the sender signing for themselves. Pays rent.

accounts.name: coin_mint
docs: The game coin. Only `mint_auth` can mint it, and only this program can sign as `mint_auth`.

accounts.name: authority
docs: The game admin acting for a custodial player, or the wallet itself. Pays rent.

errors.name: RoundFullyAwarded
errors.msg: Every player attested for this round has already been paid

errors.name: EmptyRound
errors.msg: A round must have at least one player

errors.name: Unauthorized
errors.msg: Signer must be the game admin or the wallet itself

errors.name: SelfKudos
errors.msg: You can't send kudos to yourself

errors.name: KudosTooLarge
errors.msg: Kudos must be between 1 and the configured maximum

errors.name: KudosCooldown
errors.msg: Wait a minute before sending this person kudos again

errors.name: ItemInactive
errors.msg: This item isn't for sale right now

errors.name: LevelTooLow
errors.msg: Your level is too low for this item

errors.name: GoalNotReached
errors.msg: The table hasn't reached its goal yet

errors.name: NotInSession
errors.msg: This wallet wasn't paid in this session

errors.name: ReservedAchievement
errors.msg: Achievements below bit 16 are earned automatically, not granted

fields.name: unlocked
docs: Bits unlocked by this transaction.

fields.name: achievements
docs: The player's full mask afterwards.

types.name: Award
docs: Receipt that a wallet was paid for a round. Its PDA can only be created once,
which is what stops a round from paying the same player twice.

fields.name: admin
docs: The game server's authority key; the only signer allowed to settle rounds.

types.name: Item
docs: A perk players can buy with TABLE. The game server fulfils it off chain.

fields.name: supply
docs: 0 = unlimited.

fields.name: kind
docs: Free-form category for the frontend/hub (e.g. 0 = table perk, 1 = robot action).

types.name: KudosLink
docs: Kudos history for one (from, to) pair; also enforces the cooldown.

types.name: Player
docs: One per wallet. Mirrors the numbers shown on the player's soulbound badge.

fields.name: achievements
docs: Bitmask of ACH_* constants.

types.name: Receipt
docs: Proof of a redemption, numbered per player; `fulfilled` flips when the perk is delivered.

types.name: Round
docs: Written once per round. `events_hash` is the sha256 of the round's off-chain
event log, so payouts can be checked against the data that justified them.

types.name: Session
docs: A game night's shared table goal: every coin awarded in the session fills
the pot, and once it reaches `goal` every player can claim the bonus.

types.name: SessionBonus
docs: Marks that a wallet has claimed a session's table-goal bonus.

constants.name: KUDOS_COOLDOWN_SECONDS
docs: Minimum seconds between two kudos from the same sender to the same receiver.
